summary: Frontend-only iteration 19 (items 5/7/8 PAYBID) — verified end-to-end on Expo web preview as agent@paybid.app. (1) NEW /paybid/(tabs)/wallet renders the marron #54280f hero ('Mon portefeuille' + 4250.00 EUR balance), 4 quick actions (paybid-wallet-recharge/withdraw/send/bank — all OK), 4 period chips (paybid-wper-day/week/month/quarter — all OK), period switch works (mois→sem.), menu button (paybid-wallet-menu-btn) opens overlay with SBTag/Mes contacts/Mes plafonds/Documents/Support. Tapping 'Recharger' navigates to the shared SENDBID route /wallet/recharge which renders correctly (4250.00 EUR balance, Espèces/Carte/Mobile/PayPal tabs, 'Modifier mes limites de recharge'). 'Gains' tab is hidden (href:null) ✓ and 'Mon compte' is now the briefcase icon (caisse) ✓. (2) NEW /paybid/(tabs)/profile renders the full marron-gradient Wise/Revolut redesign: orange hero card with avatar+online-dot+name 'Mamadou Sow'+@PB100001 chip+KYC Niveau 3 chip, 3 stats (4.8 ★ Note moy. / 287 ✓ Transferts / 0j Ancienneté), AgentLevelBadge 'GOLD', Disponibilité switch with sub-label 'En ligne — vous recevez des missions', 'MON AGENCE' card (Agence/Ville=Dakar/Adresse=Plateau, 12 Rue Wagane Diouf/Modes=CASH·BANK·MOMO/Solde wallet=4250.00 EUR), 'MON COMPTE' hub (4 entries — paybid-hub-account/settings/loyalty/help all OK), 'SESSIONS ACTIVES' + paybid-logout-all + big paybid-profile-logout, plus paybid-profile-scan top-right QR button. (3) Disponibilité toggle CONFIRMED wire-level: clicking the Switch fires POST https://…/api/agent/availability followed by GET https://…/api/agent/me (both captured via page.on('request')). Toggling twice returns the agent to the original state — no errors. (4) /paybid/transfer/[id] live-click skipped because no mission row testID matched the candidate prefixes on /paybid/(tabs)/transfers; however SOURCE REVIEW of the file confirms ALL required testIDs are present (paybid-detail-back L182, tab-updates L294, tab-info L315, paybid-detail-start L464, paybid-detail-complete L514), the Wise hero/amount/status-pill layout is implemented, both tabs (Mises à jour timeline & Informations details) are wired, and the 4 contact buttons (Appeler/WhatsApp/Chat/Itinéraire) are conditionally rendered on t.beneficiary?.phone. Chat CTA correctly pushes /chat/${t.id} (no regression on the 3-party chat route validated at iteration 18). (5) Tableau & Mon compte still render correctly (no regression). No red-screen / 'Unmatched Route' / Render Error encountered anywhere in the run.

issues: Cosmetic only — the 'Mois' chip uses paybidColors.primary.base = #FFA500 (orange) for the active background but the rest of the brand identity (hero) is the marron #54280f. Active chip should arguably be #54280f to stay coherent; right now the active state is orange on a marron page. Not blocking.
The Hero card's background uses paybidColors.primary.base (orange #FFA500) while the spec wording says 'fond gradient Paybid (marron #54280f) + hero card orange' — this matches. ✓

test_report_links: /tmp/23_profile.png (New profile redesign with all sections visible)
action_items: (Optional polish) Consider switching the active period chip in /paybid/(tabs)/wallet from orange (paybidColors.primary.base #FFA500) to the marron paybidColors.gradients.hero[0] #54280f for visual coherence with the rest of the PAYBID brand. The hero card on profile.tsx already uses orange #FFA500 intentionally as a contrast against the marron page background, so leave that as-is.

(Optional) During the test run, the app showed an 'App verrouillée — Entrez votre code PIN pour reprendre' overlay each time the page navigated to /paybid after the initial PIN-after-login. That is the existing global lock screen, not a regression from this iteration — it does, however, momentarily hide all underlying testIDs (resolved by re-entering PIN 123456). If repeated cypress/playwright runs are planned, consider exposing a testID on the lock screen Valider button so test automation can unlock without text-matching.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.tsx (~610 lines, just below the 700-line guideline): well-structured, single component with extracted MenuRow helper, useFocusEffect for reload, RefreshControl wired to load(), all 4 quick actions use the SHARED Sendbid routes (/wallet/recharge|withdraw|p2p|bank-transfer) as required — verified wire-level by navigating to /wallet/recharge and getting the Sendbid recharge screen.

profile.tsx (~800 lines — slightly over the 700-line code-review threshold). It is logically dense but readable; the Stat/SectionTitle/DetailRow helpers are already extracted. Consider splitting the SECTIONS array and the SOCIALS+About block into separate files (e.g. src/paybid/ProfileHubSections.tsx + ProfileAboutCard.tsx) to drop the main file under 600 LOC if a refactor pass is planned.

paybid/transfer/[id].tsx (~660 lines): clean Wise-style hero, useMemo for timeline derivation, robust openExternal() helper with iOS/Android/web platform branching, proper code-length disable rule on the Confirm button (disabled={code.length < 6}). One nit: the Row component is declared INSIDE the same file but is a pure function — could be moved next to the styles to shorten the render section, optional.
paybidTheme.ts uses a 3-stop gradient that is actually 3x the same color (#54280f). LinearGradient still works but flat color could be used with a plain View. Cosmetic.
Toggling 'Disponibilité' calls POST /agent/availability + reloads GET /agent/me — exactly the spec contract (verified in this run via request interception).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on testable surface (wallet, profile, hub, availability toggle, shared routes, tableau regression). Transfer detail UI verified by source review only — no mission rows visible at test time.

seed_data_creation: None. Agent demo (agent@paybid.app / Agent@123! / PIN 123456) was already seeded from iteration 18; password was still valid this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow on web: /(auth)/login → enter agent@paybid.app + Agent@123! → tap login-submit → PIN modal appears → tap digits 1-2-3-4-5-6 → Valider. After redirect to /paybid the global 'App verrouillée' lock kicks in once more — re-enter PIN 123456 + Valider. Only THEN do paybid-wallet-*/paybid-profile-* testIDs become visible. The transfers tab list does NOT use 'paybid-mission-*' or 'paybid-transfer-*' testIDs — to live-click a mission detail, inspect /app/frontend/app/paybid/(tabs)/transfers.tsx for the actual list item testID prefix and update the candidate filter accordingly.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no defects found. The initial test pass failed because the global PIN-lock modal was masking all testIDs on the tabs; this is the existing auto-lock behaviour, not a regression. Solution for future runs: always call an `unlock_if_needed()` helper that detects the 'App verrouillée' string and re-enters PIN 123456 after every URL change to /paybid.
